description: Configuration for filtering helper grammars that should not appear in language manifests. These are grammars used for injection, documentation, or specialized variants that are not standalone languages.

patterns.description: Embedded grammars with dot separator (e.g., cpp.embedded.macro)
Embedded grammars with hyphen separator (e.g., yaml-embedded)
Bailout grammars for error recovery (e.g., cpp-grammar-bailout)

notes: Patterns are matched using substring matching (languageId.contains(pattern))
Grammars matching any pattern will be excluded from the manifest
This helps prevent extension conflicts and ensures only standalone languages are included
